Chapter 601: Chapter 31: Founding the Martial Realm (Please Subscribe)_2

He was the first Prime God born between heaven and earth, privy to many secrets. It’s said no living being has ever seen the Supreme God, but the Prime God of Light indeed knew a secret related to the Supreme God.

“You’re talking about that palace at the deepest part of space?” Lin Yuan said nonchalantly.

Early on, when he swiftly took over many Spatial Layers, Lin Yuan sensed that there was more to the very fabric of this world’s space, something ancient—an old palace.

However, Lin Yuan was too busy pursuing the remaining Prime Gods, which is why he did not investigate immediately; he intended to deal with everything before exploring it.

Now, the direction in which the Prime God of Light was fleeing was precisely that ancient palace located at the ultimate depths of space.

“You know?” the Prime God of Light couldn’t believe it. He was the first to discover that mysterious palace and speculated that it was related to the Supreme God, but he never found any more useful information.

...

“You are too weak.”

“At my level, there’s hardly any secret left in this world.” Lin Yuan shook his head slightly, once again bridging a great distance between Spatial Layers.

Lin Yuan had now created one hundred and twenty million Spatial Layers, while the number of Spatial Layers in the world itself was only around a trillion or so.

In other words, if Lin Yuan wished, he could fully explore all the Spatial Layers of this world by spending some time, thanks to the volume of his own Spatial Layers.

The many secrets hidden within layers upon layers of space were no secret to Lin Yuan.

“Die.”

Lin Yuan had closed in on the Prime God of Light without limit.

“Is this what death feels like?” The Prime God of Light suddenly stopped moving, as his Divine Body and soul were eradicated.

“The Divine Lattice of Light?”

Lin Yuan reached out with his right hand, and a divine lattice emanating infinite light appeared in his palm.

“Hm?”

“It actually contains endless light and a part of the Rule of Time essence?” Lin Yuan raised an eyebrow, slightly surprised.

The Prime God of Light, indeed the first among Prime Gods, undoubtedly had the strongest strength among the twenty-four Prime Gods, with his divine lattice containing the essence of two rules.

Although it did not compare to the Rainbow Dragon God’s essence of seven rules, both endless light and time were among the most powerful rule essences.

“However, during the escape just now, the Prime God of Light didn’t utilize any time-related abilities…” Lin Yuan contemplated for only a moment before he realized the reason.

The Rule of Time, as profound and abstruse as it is, also had to consider the comparison of strengths between the two parties.

For example, the most basic ability to pause time, in a close combat situation, is indeed useful, for fighting or fleeing, it belongs to a first-rate ‘Divine Skill’.

But when there is a huge difference in strength and the essence of life, it’s useless.

Even rash usage might produce negative effects.

If time were viewed as a Long River, then stopping time would be akin to setting up a ‘net’ at a certain segment.

Trapping life that follows the river’s flow, causing it to come to a halt.

But if the life one wishes to trap is a massive whale, far exceeding the ‘net’s’ bearing limit.

Then the only outcome would be that the net breaks, and the whale would not pause at all.

The Prime God of Light probably realized the excessively strong essence of Lin Yuan’s life, and thus, until his death, he never employed any time-related abilities.

Because they would be meaningless.

In fact, not just the Rule of Time, all other rule abilities, talents, and even Divine Skills are practically useless when the disparity in strength reaches a certain level.

Just like Lin Yuan now, without employing any techniques and purely relying on the Inner World that had one hundred and twenty million Spatial Layers, he could crush any Ninth-Rank life form.

Even if it was a life with a terrifyingly unique talent, there was no chance for it to resist in front of Lin Yuan.

Under absolute strength, all methods are but frivolousness and show.

“Now that I’ve already come here…” Lin Yuan put away the Divine Lattice of Light and looked towards the ancient palace at the deepest part of space.

Originally, Lin Yuan had planned to explore it once everything else had been taken care of, but now that he was here, he might as well take the opportunity to check it out.

Whoosh.

The Taiyang Divine Spirit appeared beside him.

After transferring all the divine lattices from his Inner World to the Taiyang Divine Spirit’s Inner World, Lin Yuan took a step forward and arrived at the deepest recesses of space.

Even though Lin Yuan considered himself invincible in this world, he did not harbor any overweening thoughts.

With the presence of the two great Primordial Spirits outside and having specifically left behind many droplets of his essence blood, even if Lin Yuan were to perish within the mysterious palace, it would not be a loss.

Hum.

The mysterious palace was majestic and grand, with a terrifying pressure that filled the air, a pressure so daunting that even mighty Prime Gods could only resist with difficulty.

This was also why the Prime God of Light thought that this palace was related to the Supreme God—apart from the Supreme God, who else could build a palace of such a level?

“`

“Supreme God?”

Lin Yuan strolled leisurely down the main palace avenue, inwardly on slight alert.

With his strength, he could ignore those oppressive forces, but this space was clearly not the work of a Prime God. If there really was a Supreme God present, perhaps it was indeed the work of such an entity.

Half a day later.

Lin Yuan had basically toured the entire palace.

“Just a palace?” Lin Yuan observed carefully, even infiltrating deeper into the Spatial Layers, but still discovered nothing.

“It holds no value to me.” Lin Yuan shook his head slightly. He had observed the palace for a good half-day without gaining any insights, which paled in comparison to the Divine Lattice.

“Perhaps this palace hails from an even more distant past,” Lin Yuan contemplated in silence.

The era of gods originated with the Light God, but what preceded the Light God?

It was far too remote.

As for Supreme Gods?

At Lin Yuan’s current level, he could see the limits of this world.

That was the Ninth Rank.

And Supreme Gods were considered by all to exist beyond the Ninth Rank.

Though Lin Yuan’s strength far exceeded that of a Prime God, and his Life Essence was frighteningly profound, he was still at the Ninth Rank stage, not having stepped into the Tenth.

To surpass the Ninth Rank, probably only the World Consciousness of this world could achieve it.

Lin Yuan was not unfamiliar with World Consciousness, an almost selfless instinct born from the world itself.

It was also known as “Heavenly Tao.”

During his previous traversals, Lin Yuan had encountered the World Consciousness several times.

Since the era of gods, this world’s consciousness had been subtly guiding the grand trends, albeit vaguely.

Lin Yuan held no dread or fear towards the World Will, because it wasn’t life, it harbored no concrete emotions.

As long as Lin Yuan didn’t harbor thoughts of destroying the world, the World Consciousness wouldn’t overly oppose him.

During his fourth traversal, in the Five Regions World, as the great demon Xiahou Yuan, the World Consciousness had targeted him, but that was all.

It had taken no direct action.

“Let’s head back.”

Lin Yuan gave the palace one last glance and turned to leave.

…

Swoosh.

Lin Yuan returned to the mortal realm.

“I still need to contain my aura…”

Lin Yuan’s aura began to converge. At his Life Level, even a slight leak could influence his surroundings, even converting everything into his own “domain.”

Moreover, the mortal realm’s space subtly restricted Lin Yuan, making him feel as though he were a beached whale.

In fact, it wasn’t just Lin Yuan, even the gods, even those who were Lower-Rank Gods, would feel similarly constrained.

Why did gods reside in the Ocean of Light or the Dark Abyss? Apart from the concern that their unconscious aura leakage would cause “alteration” to all beings, it was also because the mortal realm would bind them.

Conversely, in the Ocean of Light or the Dark Abyss, there were no such limitations. Supported by numerous Spatial Layers, even a Prime God could act freely.

“It seems I also need to create my own Spatial Layers?”

Lin Yuan decided inwardly. Although he could suppress and contain his aura, now that he was unbeatable, there was no need to continue like before, concealing and suppressing it for fear of attracting the attention of the gods.

“Creating Spatial Layers…”

Lin Yuan looked up. The Light God could create the Ocean of Light; the Dark God, the Dark Abyss; naturally, he could also create a vast world.

Accurately speaking, it wasn’t about creating but rather completing and transforming the foundation of the existing Spatial Layers.

To truly create a complete and independent world, one must fully understand the complete Rule of Time and Space.

The Inner Worlds of the Main World’s Eighth Layer powerhouses all relied on the Main World itself and could not be considered independent worlds.

“What should I name the world I am going to create…”

Lin Yuan’s face reflected contemplation, but he immediately had an answer, “Let’s call it the Martial Realm.”
